summary.headline: Astrological Omens and Astrolabe Treatises
summary.text: Codex 17 lists astrological procedures for wars, fugitives or lost objects, zodiac-sign properties, newly planted things, and marriage begun under the Moon, followed by weather omens from the Sun and Moon in codex 18, stellar signs in codex 19, and astrolabe treatises by Philoponus in codex 20. Cross-references cite codices 7, 10, and 25, and Lydus’s De Ostentis edited by Wachsmuth.
